# META-INSIGHTS — about the optimization PROCESS itself (this run)

Not about the capability — about HOW this run is searching for it: which strategies/edit classes/algorithms are helping vs stalling, and what to try next iteration. Update at the end of the run at minimum; sooner if a plateau or a clear strategy shift is worth recording now. Structure each addition as:

    ## Iteration <id> (or 'run so far')
    - Strategy tried, and whether it moved val (cite LEDGER rows):
    - Plateau/stall signal, if any, and the lever switched to:
    - What to try next iteration:

<!-- cap-evolve:meta-insights-append-below -->

## Iteration cand_0001 (run so far)
- Strategy tried: full diagnosis of `./trajectories/`, then the deliberate choice to ship no
  capability edit. Did not move val (nothing could) — all 10 tasks are Docker-build infra
  aborts with empty traces.
- Plateau/stall signal: this is NOT a search plateau — it is a blocked evaluation environment
  (`registry-1.docker.io` DNS timeout at image build). No edit-class lever can help; the signal
  itself is absent. Correctly resisting the "seek a robustness gain" prompt is the right call
  here: with 0 solid tasks and 0 real trajectories, a "generalization" edit would be an
  unverifiable guess against well-formed skills — pure downside.
- What to try next iteration: gate the run on infra health first — confirm the base image is
  reachable/cached before spending an optimizer iteration. When traces are all empty with the
  same build-time network error, treat the iteration as a no-op + document, not as an
  invitation to edit blind.
